episode.description_ar: الاستماع إلى كلمة ثم اختيار الشيء الصحيح

production_notes: The source remains draft and is not modified by this preproduction plan.
Audio-to-image accessibility fallbacks are player or UI overlays, never model-rendered or burned into video.

shared_locks.style: Original high-end contemporary stylized 3D preschool feature animation. Polished studio-quality rendering, rounded appealing character design, expressive facial animation, soft physically based materials, subtle subsurface skin shading, detailed cloth with clean folds, cinematic global illumination, warm volumetric rim light, gentle depth of field, rich dimensional environments, smooth natural body mechanics, and premium color grading. The result must look current and cinematic, not like flat educational clip art.
shared_locks.luna: Luna is the same consistent five-year-old Arab girl in every clip: warm tan skin, round cheeks, large expressive brown eyes, soft eyebrows, small friendly nose, golden-yellow hijab fully covering her hair and neck, a small silver crescent pin at her left shoulder, knee-length golden-yellow long-sleeve tunic, dark teal trousers, and dark teal shoes. Child proportions, four fingers plus thumb per hand, same face, same outfit, same materials, and same scale in all shots.
shared_locks.najmi: Najmi is the same palm-sized living five-point golden star in every clip, with rounded points, two small dark-brown eyes, one tiny friendly mouth, no arms, no legs, no accessories. Najmi floats slowly and gives a restrained cyan volumetric glow when guiding attention. Najmi never speaks words.
shared_locks.base_world: Planet Abjad is a magical safe 3D learning garden under a deep navy cosmic sky: softly rolling indigo hills, warm cream paths, rounded coral and cyan plants, tiny golden stars, soft atmospheric depth, and no readable letters. It feels bright, warm, premium, spacious, and safe for ages three to five.
shared_locks.camera: Cinematic child-eye-level 16:9 camera, gentle dolly or slow arc only, stable horizon, readable staging, no handheld shake, no rapid zoom, no fast cuts, no extreme lens distortion.
shared_locks.negative: No 2D illustration, no flat vector art, no cutout animation, no old television-cartoon look, no model sheet, no storyboard, no checkerboard, no on-screen text, no captions, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no extra people, no duplicate Luna, no duplicate Najmi, no extra limbs, no visible hair, no wardrobe change, no frightening darkness, no storm, no flashing, no violence, and no object morphing.
shared_locks.voice: One consistent youthful warm Arabic female character voice performs Luna in every clip. The voice is light, friendly, clear, curious, and natural, never an announcer, never robotic, never babyish, and never shouted. Use clear simplified Modern Standard Arabic with natural educated Egyptian articulation.
shared_locks.dialogue_rule: Speak every exact Arabic line exactly as supplied, without translation, paraphrase, added words, repeated words, labels, narrator commentary, or gibberish. Luna is the only speaking character. Match Luna's mouth accurately whenever she is visible; when absent, use the same voice gently off-camera.
shared_locks.mix: Dialogue is always foreground and intelligible. Use soft magical orchestral-marimba underscore at low volume, gentle ambience, one short crystalline chime for Najmi, and restrained success sparkles. No other voices, no singing, no loud percussion, no sudden sound, and no music covering speech.
shared_locks.silence_rule: Thinking pauses are real silence in dialogue; retain only very low ambience during them.

episode_direction.world: A listening-focused Planet Abjad garden with calm open staging, a friendly dimensional ear icon, and separate cyan sound-wave UI cues. The icon and cues never contain text.
episode_direction.props: Stable toy-like sun, clear water vessel, warm flower, rounded safe door, and the recurring friendly ginger cat review prop. Every choice remains visually distinct and spatially separated.
episode_direction.pronunciation: Pronounce شَمس with a clear sh sound and fatha; ماء with an audible long vowel and final hamza; زَهرة with a distinct z sound, never s; and بابْ with final sukun and no trailing kasra. Each isolated target word is spoken twice with one full second between repetitions. In the closing list, pause about 400 milliseconds between target words.

requirements: Show a short cyan sound-wave cue whenever a target word is spoken.
Provide the source-required written fallback for audio-to-image interactions.
Keep captions and labels out of model-generated frames.

timeline.action: One restrained success sparkle.
